text:
alen (pm): Opening a short thread for a tenant-feedback-focused rollout variant. Goal: run an opt-in canary that couples automated gates with a lightweight CS feedback loop so we can rapidly capture customer-perceived quality and correlate with telemetry. Thoughts?

alen (pm): Proposal steps:
1) internal mirror 2h + synthetic probes;
2) opt-in micro: 8 tenants, 0.5% live (max 10rps/tenant), A/B 1:1, 4h bake + 24h observation;
3) feedback-window: during the first 24h CS will send a 3-question micro-survey to participants (quality, latency satisfaction, any noticeable regressions);
4) stratum widen: expand by tenant size and prompt length if both telemetry and CS feedback are positive;
5) GA: gradual regional ramp.

mina (eng): Engineering notes: flags must support a small metadata field "cs_survey_id" linking the tenant to the survey instance. Controller will only scale percent if data pass both auto gates and CS sentiment (>=80% satisfied). We'll add a flag state "paused_by_cs" to capture manual holds.

jay (data): Metrics approach: pair automated gates (p50/p95 latency, embedding cosine, top-1 swap) with a CS sentiment score. Compute a composite health score: 0..1 weighted (0.7 telemetry, 0.3 CS). Require composite >= 0.9 to scale beyond 5%. For small cohorts use bootstrap CI and require 6h stability.

tory (sre): Circuit breakers: auto-divert on p95 > 2x baseline for 5m OR error delta > 0.4% for 10m. If CS reports repeated customer complaints (>1 complaint per tenant in 6h) set "paused_by_cs" and page SRE. Region auto-divert requires 3 tenants tripping in 20m. Manual unpause after review. Add warmup throttle 12rps/tenant during cache prefill.

sara (cs): Practical ops: we'll send a one-click survey with three fields (satisfied/neutral/unhappy, short text, permission to share logs). If unhappy, the survey auto-opens a CS ticket and includes the survey_id and reason_code. We'll surface the survey result in the tenant's console with a link to diagnostics. Also allow tenants to opt-out of surveys.

alen (pm): Example flag payload (stringified for infra): {"name":"prod.ff.routing.feedback.optin","default":"false","allowed_tenants":"[\"acct_demo\"]","cs_survey_id":"survey_2026_03","min_sample_count":"1000","min_time_window_mins":"120","warmup_rps_per_tenant":"12","owner":"alen"}

mina (eng): We'll emit an event when a tenant's CS survey indicates "unhappy" so it appears in the rollout dashboard and can trigger a manual hold. Also add an audit record linking the survey_id to flag state changes.

jay (data): Reporting: daily composite health report + 6h quick-check. For correlation: publish a small table of per-tenant survey_rate, mean cosine delta, p95 delta, and any cost delta. We'll auto-alert if composite drops > 0.08.

tory (sre): Oncall playbook: when "paused_by_cs" or auto-divert occurs, page SRE, mark flag state, collect diagnostics, and run quick triage. If multiple tenants report similar text patterns in survey free text, escalate to Product for content review.

sara (cs): I'll draft the survey copy and the email/snippet we'll use in-console. Also will prepare the template for the follow-up that includes the diagnostics link.

audit-bot: Created flag prod.ff.routing.feedback.optin in staging at 2198765432 and recorded survey template survey_2026_03.

alen (pm): Actions & ETAs: mina - controller + flag metadata + audit link (ETA Wed); jay - composite health doc + dashboard panels (ETA Tue); tory - circuit breaker + playbook snippet (ETA Thu); sara - survey copy + templates (ETA Mon). If no objections schedule internal mirror next Thurs. Ack here.

mina (eng): ack.

jay (data): ack.

tory (sre): ack.

sara (cs): ack, will prep copy.
